items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: I asked him, I said, why are you playing the baritone? He said, that's the best I could do.

ctx.x: You mean a brass baritone horn? Yeah. Yeah. I asked him, I said, why are you playing the baritone? He said, that's the best I could do. I'd have anything else to play on.
Well, at least he was honest about it. Yeah. Were the Holy Rollers a pretty big group?
